general.name: Bitfocus Companion Satellite protocol
general.comment: The Companion Satellite wire protocol and connection behaviour implemented here were derived by studying Bitfocus's Stream Deck Companion plugin. No source code was copied; this is an independent Python reimplementation of the observable behaviour.

plugin.name: Bitfocus Companion plugin for StreamController
plugin.comment: Licensed GPLv3 to match StreamController, the application this plugin runs inside.
